# Pinned QianJi converter snapshot

This fixture contains unmodified files from the private upstream QianJi
repository at commit:

`3f3676c6cb7c198f7c9c43ce0b002f61d3d524a8`

Included files:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `mujoco_builder/json2xml_v7_perrod.py` | `77ebb0857042b48556abff65f54c7e51c7beec94cc468cf2ba8c2a655c4f77d4` |
| `mujoco_builder/robot_config.py` | `176699944ecfd0d1f597e86eafcf45d7cbc28f35213e53c8579a9058eee9cf19` |
| `LICENSE` | `c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4` |

The snapshot exists because one repository's GitHub Actions token cannot clone
another private repository. CI verifies every file hash before executing the
real pinned converter. The upstream license is Apache License 2.0 and is
included unchanged as `LICENSE`.
